Hi, I'm Joshua Chu! I'm a game developer and designer with a passion for creating engaging and immersive experiences. I am currently studying Computer Science at the University of California, Santa Barbara, where I am the president of the Game Development Club. I enjoy exploring new concepts and pushing the boundaries of game development, which I exercise most often through my game projects and D&D homebrew.

If you'd like to get in touch, feel free to reach out via email or connect with me on social media!
